facts.text: Concordia was one of two moons orbiting the Outer Rim world of Mandalore.

evidence.quote: Concordia was one of two moons orbiting the Outer Rim world of Mandalore.

facts.text: A verdant moon possessing dense forests, the Mandalorians originally settled Concordia as an agricultural colony.

evidence.quote: A verdant moon possessing dense forests, the Mandalorians originally settled Concordia as an agricultural colony.

facts.text: However, during the time of war, the Mandalorians established a vast number of mining camps on the moon in search of beskar iron, a nearly indestructible metal ore unique to Mandalore and its orbiting satellite.

evidence.quote: However, during the time of war, the Mandalorians established a vast number of mining camps on the moon in search of beskar iron, a nearly indestructible metal ore unique to Mandalore and its orbiting satellite.

facts.text: By the beginning of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Concordia was governed by Pre Vizsla, a public supporter of New Mandalorian leader Duchess Satine Kryze, but secretly the leader of a reborn faction of Death Watch.

evidence.quote: By the beginning of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Concordia was governed by Pre Vizsla, a public supporter of New Mandalorian leader Duchess Satine Kryze, but secretly the leader of a reborn faction of Death Watch.

facts.text: Vizsla established a Death Watch base in the moon's abandoned mines, where he worked in secret to rebuild the Death Watch.

evidence.quote: Vizsla established a Death Watch base in the moon's abandoned mines, where he worked in secret to rebuild the Death Watch.

facts.text: His base was discovered by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi during an investigation of the Death Watch's presence in current Mandalorian affairs, and his efforts to turn the New Mandalorians against the Republic were thwarted by the combined actions of Kenobi and Duchess Kryze.

evidence.quote: His base was discovered by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi during an investigation of the Death Watch's presence in current Mandalorian affairs, and his efforts to turn the New Mandalorians against the Republic were thwarted by the combined actions of Kenobi and Duchess Kryze.

facts.text: With Vizsla's ties to Death Watch were exposed to all, he lost his position as governor of Concordia, and was eventually forced to abandon the Mandalorian moon to join Death Watch in a nomadic existence wandering the galaxy, until he led a coup against the New Mandalorians to take power.

evidence.quote: With Vizsla's ties to Death Watch were exposed to all, he lost his position as governor of Concordia, and was eventually forced to abandon the Mandalorian moon to join Death Watch in a nomadic existence wandering the galaxy, until he led a coup against the New Mandalorians to take power.

facts.text: Concordia was a terrestrial moon, one of two satellites that orbited the planet Mandalore, the cultural homeworld of the Mandalorian people, located in the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Concordia was a terrestrial moon, one of two satellites that orbited the planet Mandalore, the cultural homeworld of the Mandalorian people, located in the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: One of several habitable locations in the Mandalore system, Concordia was a lush, temperate moon, with chains of mountains dotting its surface.

evidence.quote: One of several habitable locations in the Mandalore system, Concordia was a lush, temperate moon, with chains of mountains dotting its surface.

facts.text: As the system's sun set, Concordia could be seen from the surface of Mandalore as a green sphere in the evening sky.

evidence.quote: As the system's sun set, Concordia could be seen from the surface of Mandalore as a green sphere in the evening sky.

facts.text: A verdant moon where dense forests grew, Concordia became an agricultural colony after being settled by the Mandalorians.

evidence.quote: A verdant moon where dense forests grew, Concordia became an agricultural colony after being settled by the Mandalorians.

facts.text: The Mandalorian moon was home to a number of animals, including carnivorous predators who were known to chance attacking sentient prey at night.

evidence.quote: The Mandalorian moon was home to a number of animals, including carnivorous predators who were known to chance attacking sentient prey at night.

facts.text: Individuals who ventured out into the Concordian plains in the dark could ward off the moon's predators with fire.

evidence.quote: Individuals who ventured out into the Concordian plains in the dark could ward off the moon's predators with fire.

facts.text: During the period when Mandalore continued to engage in large-scale warfare, Concordia became the target of beskar iron miners, who scoured the moon for the nearly indestructible metal.

evidence.quote: During the period when Mandalore continued to engage in large-scale warfare, Concordia became the target of beskar iron miners, who scoured the moon for the nearly indestructible metal.

facts.text: Unsightly mines marred much of Concordia's surface, almost destroying the moon's forests in the process.

evidence.quote: Unsightly mines marred much of Concordia's surface, almost destroying the moon's forests in the process.

facts.text: As they set out to capture the surrounding worlds of the Mandalore system, the Mandalorians eventually turned their sights on the lush and forested moon of Concordia.

evidence.quote: As they set out to capture the surrounding worlds of the Mandalore system, the Mandalorians eventually turned their sights on the lush and forested moon of Concordia.

facts.text: Over time, the verdant moon became an agricultural settlement, inhabited and tended by Mandalorian farmers.

evidence.quote: Over time, the verdant moon became an agricultural settlement, inhabited and tended by Mandalorian farmers.

facts.text: As the Mandalorians continued to wage war centuries prior to rise of the Galactic Empire, they sought beskar iron ore from beneath the surface of Concordia.

evidence.quote: As the Mandalorians continued to wage war centuries prior to rise of the Galactic Empire, they sought beskar iron ore from beneath the surface of Concordia.

facts.text: The metal was a galactic rarity, found only on Mandalore and its moon, and was prized for its nigh invulnerability, capable of withstanding the blows of a lightsaber.

evidence.quote: The metal was a galactic rarity, found only on Mandalore and its moon, and was prized for its nigh invulnerability, capable of withstanding the blows of a lightsaber.

facts.text: Ugly mines came to scar the surface of Concordia, and the Mandalorians' strip-mining efforts were so extensive that the moon's native forests were nearly destroyed.

evidence.quote: Ugly mines came to scar the surface of Concordia, and the Mandalorians' strip-mining efforts were so extensive that the moon's native forests were nearly destroyed.

facts.text: Following the Mandalorian Excision—a brief but overwhelming conflict between the Mandalorians and the Galactic Republic that transformed portions of Mandalore into barren deserts of white sand—a reformist political faction of Mandalorians was born: the New Mandalorians.

evidence.quote: Following the Mandalorian Excision—a brief but overwhelming conflict between the Mandalorians and the Galactic Republic that transformed portions of Mandalore into barren deserts of white sand—a reformist political faction of Mandalorians was born: the New Mandalorians.

facts.text: Control of the Mandalorian moon was turned over to Clan Vizsla, to act as a province independent of the New Mandalorian state.

evidence.quote: Control of the Mandalorian moon was turned over to Clan Vizsla, to act as a province independent of the New Mandalorian state.

facts.text: By the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, more than a decade after the end of the Great Clan Wars, it was the position of the New Mandalorian government that the warriors that had been exiled to Concordia had died since out.

evidence.quote: By the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, more than a decade after the end of the Great Clan Wars, it was the position of the New Mandalorian government that the warriors that had been exiled to Concordia had died since out.

facts.text: During this time, Concordia was ruled by Governor Pre Vizsla, an outward supporter of the New Mandalorians and friend to their leader, Duchess Satine Kryze.

evidence.quote: During this time, Concordia was ruled by Governor Pre Vizsla, an outward supporter of the New Mandalorians and friend to their leader, Duchess Satine Kryze.

facts.text: Vizsla established a base of operations in the abandoned beskar mines of Concordia, using the facilities to manufacture Mandalorian armor and armament, and as a staging ground for his Death Watch forces.

evidence.quote: Vizsla established a base of operations in the abandoned beskar mines of Concordia, using the facilities to manufacture Mandalorian armor and armament, and as a staging ground for his Death Watch forces.

facts.text: Vizsla's plans and the Death Watch's secret base were uncovered by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Duchess Kryze during a visit to Concordia in the early months of the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Vizsla's plans and the Death Watch's secret base were uncovered by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Duchess Kryze during a visit to Concordia in the early months of the Clone Wars.

facts.text: Discovered, Vizsla fought Kenobi to a draw, and a trio of his Death Watch troops forced the Jedi Master to retreat with the Duchess back to Mandalore.

evidence.quote: Discovered, Vizsla fought Kenobi to a draw, and a trio of his Death Watch troops forced the Jedi Master to retreat with the Duchess back to Mandalore.

facts.text: Even still, Vizsla continued to use Concordia and his base there as a staging ground for a planned Death Watch takeover of Mandalore.

evidence.quote: Even still, Vizsla continued to use Concordia and his base there as a staging ground for a planned Death Watch takeover of Mandalore.

facts.text: There, he amassed an army of soldiers, but before an attack could be made, Count Dooku—Vizsla's ally in the Confederacy of Independent Systems—ordered his men to stand down due to the veto of a Republic defense initiative that would have sent a contingent of clone troopers to Mandalore.

evidence.quote: There, he amassed an army of soldiers, but before an attack could be made, Count Dooku—Vizsla's ally in the Confederacy of Independent Systems—ordered his men to stand down due to the veto of a Republic defense initiative that would have sent a contingent of clone troopers to Mandalore.

facts.text: Vizsla and Dooku had planned to use the Republic occupation to sway the Mandalorian populace to support Death Watch as would-be liberators against an oppressive offworld force.

evidence.quote: Vizsla and Dooku had planned to use the Republic occupation to sway the Mandalorian populace to support Death Watch as would-be liberators against an oppressive offworld force.

facts.text: Without the backing of Mandalore's people, Death Watch did not have the strength to take control of the planet.

evidence.quote: Without the backing of Mandalore's people, Death Watch did not have the strength to take control of the planet.

facts.text: Areas of the moon were known to host an ostensible presence of the Black Sun crime syndicate, operating under the oversight of Vigo Xizor's lieutenant, Tyno Fabris.

evidence.quote: Areas of the moon were known to host an ostensible presence of the Black Sun crime syndicate, operating under the oversight of Vigo Xizor's lieutenant, Tyno Fabris.

facts.text: Non-Mandalorian offworlders with business on the Mandalorian homeworld would occasionally make planetfall on Concordia to fulfill their needs, rather than journeying down to the surface of Mandalore itself.

evidence.quote: Non-Mandalorian offworlders with business on the Mandalorian homeworld would occasionally make planetfall on Concordia to fulfill their needs, rather than journeying down to the surface of Mandalore itself.

facts.text: Concordia was first inhabited by members of the Mandalorian culture as an agricultural settlement, becoming a home to a number of Mandalorian farmers.

evidence.quote: Concordia was first inhabited by members of the Mandalorian culture as an agricultural settlement, becoming a home to a number of Mandalorian farmers.

facts.text: Later, the moon was transformed into a mining base, and Concordia became a haven for beskar miners, operating the numerous mines littered across the moon's surface.

facts.text: The rule of the Mandalorian moon was entrusted to the members of Clan Vizsla, and by the time of the Clone Wars, Concordia was recognized as an independent province, separate from the New Mandalorian state and ruled by its own governor.
